headline: North Georgia stand alone as the last unbeaten side
dek: North Georgia are still the only side in the conference without a defeat, six wins and five draws into the season, with 26 goals scored and thirteen conceded. The draws in conference play, though, leave them behind Flagler in the table and level with Clayton State.
displaced_by: Clayton State's win at Georgia Southwestern drew them level with North Georgia on points, so the dek's 'second to Flagler' no longer held; headline unchanged, closing clause corrected

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's 26 goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: North Georgia are still unbeaten, but a run of draws has let Flagler, beaten once, go top of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches have passed their date with no published result, the most recent of them Clayton State's visit to Lander in September.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 35 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 21.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored ten of Middle Georgia State's 21 goals from 32 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored eight of North Georgia's 26 goals from 28 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored seven of Georgia Southwestern's eleven goals from fifteen shots.

last_match.line: Flagler are still unbeaten in conference play; Middle Georgia State's defeat is the latest in a losing run.

next_match.line: Flagler won the first meeting at home in September; Clayton State have not lost since.
